function.name: mcp__github__fetch_issue
function.description:
Access repositories, issues, and pull requests. Required for some features such as Codex

Fetch a GitHub issue. You must populate exactly one of `repository_full_name`, `repository_id`, or `repository_url` to select the issue's repository. This tool is part of plugin `Codex Security`.

repository_full_name.description: Repository in `owner/name` form, such as `openai/openai`. This maps to GitHub REST `owner` and `repo` path parameters: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/repos/repos#get-a-repository

repository_id.description: Numeric GitHub repository ID, such as `1296269`. Use this only when the stable repository `id` from a GitHub repository object is available: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/repos/repos#get-a-repository

repository_url.description: GitHub repository URL, or a nested repository URL such as a pull request, issue, branch, or file URL. Examples: `https://github.com/openai/openai/pulls/123`, `https://api.github.com/repos/openai/openai`, `https://github.example.com/api/v3/repos/octo/repo`. Supports GitHub Enterprise Server custom hostnames and GHE.com API hosts. Docs: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/repos/repos#get-a-repository and https://docs.github.com/en/enterprise-server@latest/rest/using-the-rest-api/getting-started-with-the-rest-api and https://docs.github.com/en/enterprise-cloud@latest/admin/data-residency/about-github-enterprise-cloud-with-data-residency#api-access

function.name: mcp__github__update_issue
function.description:
Access repositories, issues, and pull requests. Required for some features such as Codex

Update a GitHub issue, including title/body, state, labels, assignees, or milestone. Returns a normalized issue snapshot after the patch. Docs: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/issues/issues?apiVersion=2022-11-28#update-an-issue. This tool is part of plugin `Codex Security`.

assignees.description: Optional full assignee list to set on the issue. This replaces the assignee set rather than adding to it.

labels.description: Optional full label list to set on the issue. This replaces the label set rather than adding to it.

milestone.description: Optional milestone number to set on the issue. This wrapper does not expose an explicit way to clear an existing milestone.

repository_full_name.description: Repository in `owner/name` form, such as `openai/openai`. This maps to GitHub REST `owner` and `repo` path parameters: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/repos/repos#get-a-repository

state.description: Optional issue state. Use closed to close or open to reopen.

state_reason.description: Optional state reason. GitHub uses this only with state changes. This wrapper supports `completed`, `not_planned`, `duplicate`, and `reopened`.
